info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Technology Standards Management API
info.description: This API serves as a central resource for managing technology standards within banking IT management. It enables organizations to establish, update, and maintain compliance with various technology standards across their operations. By facilitating the posting of new standards and modifications, this API assists IT teams in ensuring consistency and security in technological implementations. Typical consumers include IT administrators and compliance officers who seek to integrate or align their systems with the latest standard requirements.

post.summary: Create a new technology standard in IT management.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new technology standard within the IT management framework. By providing the necessary details in the request body, an organization can establish specific technology standards for various IT processes to ensure consistency and compliance across the board.
